$comment: Single source of truth for the Archon OS identity. Everything in assets/brand/*.png is DERIVED from the .svg files here via build.sh — regenerate, never hand-edit. Pattern borrowed from ai-mv-factory's prompts/style-book/*.json.
name: Archon OS
tagline: A planning-first LLM operating system for software engineering.

mark.subject: owl
mark.why: An archon is an Athenian magistrate, and the owl is Athena's — the one that watches. The dispatch model now has a literal observer role (rules/workflow/three-role-dispatch.md), so the mark is the watcher, not a decoration.
mark.style: flat geometric, no gradients, no glow
mark.predecessor: the Aura Frog frog mark — retired with the name at v4.0.0

accent_rule: Amber is the single accent and it is reserved for the thing that renders a verdict — the owl's beak, the underline. Do not use it for decoration.

typography.wordmark: custom monoline geometric letterforms drawn as SVG paths — not a licensed font, so it renders identically everywhere
